title: Occupancy and Residency Certification: Settling Period After a Death Notice
content:
The **settling period** taken away when scheduled contacts of an in-care borrower are counted on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile depends on the accepted death notices on file for the profile:

| Accepted death notices on file | Settling period |
|---|---|
| one received less than 3 whole calendar months before the handling date | 21 calendar days |
| on file, but none received that recently | 10 calendar days |
| none | zero days |

Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

*Boundary (hypothetical dates).* A death notice received 12 January counts as recent on a handling date of 11 April (2 whole months) and not on 12 April (3 whole months).
